```{r}
library(vcfR)
library(pegas)
library(tidyverse)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Load VCF and Population Metadata
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
knitr::opts_chunk$set(warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
# CONFIGURATION --------------- 
library(knitr)
library(tidyverse)
library(stringr)

base_dir <- "/work/williarj/williarj/2627_HJH_Thesis/"
pures_dataset <- "data/raw_input/Ebrahimi_3_3_2026_prepared/renamed_pure_jc_ja.vcf"
hybrids_dataset <- "data/raw_input/Ebrahimi_5_20_2026_prepared/renamed_samples.vcf"
chosen_dataset <- hybrids_dataset

# Test directory 
list.dirs(base_dir, full.names = FALSE, recursive = FALSE)

# Load your 66,000 loci VCF
vcf <- read.vcfR((paste0(base_dir, chosen_dataset)))
sample_names <- colnames(vcf@gt)[-1]
keep_parents_mask <- grepl("_JC|_JA", sample_names, ignore.case = TRUE)
vcf <- vcf[, c(TRUE, keep_parents_mask)]

# Map pop ids df
sample_names <- colnames(vcf@gt)[-1]
pop_info <- tibble(sample_names) %>% rename(SampleID = sample_names) %>% mutate(Population =
          case_when(str_detect(SampleID, "JC") ~ "JC",
                    str_detect(SampleID, "JA") ~ "JA",
                    TRUE ~ "No population found"))


# Ensure population order matches VCF sample order
sample_names <- colnames(vcf@gt)[-1]
pop_vector <- pop_info$Population[match(sample_names, pop_info$SampleID)]
```

# Compute Fst --> Save in output
```{r}
# Convert VCF object to pegas 'loci' class
pegas_loci <- vcfR2loci(vcf)

# Assign populations directly to the loci object or pass as a vector
# pegas::Fst expects either a 'population' column or a population factor vector
fst_matrix <- Fst(pegas_loci, pop = as.factor(pop_vector))
```

```{r}
# pegas returns a matrix with columns: FIT, FST, FIS for each locus
# Extract per-locus FST values into a clean tibble
fst_df <- tibble(
  locus_id = rownames(fst_matrix),
  FST = fst_matrix[, "Fst"]
) %>%
  drop_na(FST) %>%
  # Replace negative WC estimates with 0 for biological interpretation
  mutate(FST_clean = ifelse(FST < 0, 0, FST)) %>% select(-FST) 

# Save CSV output
output_csv_path <- file.path(paste0(base_dir, "data/outputs/summary_fst_at_loci_in_hybrid_subset.csv"))
write.csv(fst_df, output_csv_path, row.names = FALSE)
```

# Stats 
```{r}
print(summary(fst_df$FST_clean))

# Measure tail heaviness (e.g., proportion of loci > 0.5)
p_outliers <- mean(fst_df$FST_clean > 0.5)
cat(sprintf("\nProportion of loci with FST > 0.5: %.2f%%\n", p_outliers * 100))

fst_plot <- ggplot(fst_df, aes(x = FST_clean)) +
  geom_histogram(
    aes(y = after_stat(density)), 
    bins = 100, 
    fill = "#2b8cbe", 
    color = "white", 
    alpha = 0.75
  ) +
  geom_density(color = "#045a8d", linewidth = 1) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  labs(
    title = expression(paste("Per-Locus ", F[ST], " Distribution across 66,000 Loci")),
    # subtitle = "Evaluating outlier locus prevalence vs. background drift",
    x = expression(F[ST]),
    y = "Density"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.2))

print(fst_plot)
```
